TICKET
# Server error when quickview product quantity changed

Server error when quickview product quantity changed

## Attendu
No error message is displayed

## Étapes
> Listed by @yanmakouf 

1. go to FO
2. click on any product to open the product page
3. scroll down open related product quick view modal
4. increase the product quantity
5. see "undefined" error message

---
1. Open any product page with additional parameters (ie. color):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14793248/62200879-f5147f80-b38e-11e9-83a9-d83df0988c13.png)
2. Open quickview product in the category products widget:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14793248/62200926-0e1d3080-b38f-11e9-90db-b353075ebde5.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14793248/62201048-46bd0a00-b38f-11e9-8596-8a63b2a7d437.png)
3. Close quickview. Now we see an error message under original product`s "add to cart" button.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14793248/62201136-6e13d700-b38f-11e9-850d-1a8317b625fd.png)
4. Error in the browser console:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14793248/62201184-913e8680-b38f-11e9-9507-46d14b48f5fb.png)
